answer: Root tissue must outcompete weeds in a parched garden by allocating metabolic reserves toward deep taproots rather than superficial shoots. A sybil attacker faces this biological bottleneck when forced to stake verifiable computational proof-of-work into every single node, consuming vast energy just like cassava foraging for scarce water beneath a dry zephyr. If an adversary tries spawning millions of fake identities to hijack the network, the sheer cost of resource generation starves their malicious cluster, protecting the central oasis.
